title: Pip and Tumble's Wobbly Shape House
moral: When we work together, we can build amazing things.
description: Nana Hoot brings a wheelbarrow full of wooden shapes, and Pip and Tumble each want to build a playhouse all by themselves. Wobbly squares, a banana-shaped triangle and one giant sneeze later, can they find a better way? Learn circles, squares, triangles, stars and hearts in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? One sunny morning, Nana Hoot rolled out a wheelbarrow full of wooden shapes. Clunk, clunk, clunk!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good morning, dears! These shapes can build a little playhouse... if you work together. Hoo-hoo!
Then Nana's glasses slid all the way down to the tip of her beak. Wheeee!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A playhouse? Super-duper! I can build it all by myself!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Me too! I can build it all by MY-self! HONK!
Zip! Pip zoomed to the meadow and grabbed a big red shape with four straight sides.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Easy-peasy! This is a CIRCLE!
Hmm... is it a circle? What shape has four straight sides, all the same?
It's a SQUARE! One, two, three, four sides! Good job!
Pip stacked one square... two squares... three squares... wibble-wobble... KA-BONK! They all fell on his head!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I'm okay! I'm just a little bit... square-ified!

narration.text: Then Tumble tried, all by himself. He picked up a pointy yellow shape with his trunk.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I know this one! It's a... BANANA! HONK!
A banana? Silly Tumble! How many sides does it have? Let's count! One, two, three!
Three sides! It's a TRIANGLE! You're so smart!
Tumble lifted the triangle high, high, HIGH... BOING! It bounced and landed on his head like a party hat!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee-hee! You look super-duper fancy, Tumble!
Then they BOTH grabbed the same blue square. Pull! Pull! PULL!
Zip! The square slipped, and Pip and Tumble rolled round and round in the grass. Wibble-wobble!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Little ones, Pip is quick and Tumble is strong. If you work together, you can... zzzz...
Uh-oh! Nana fell asleep right in the middle of her sentence!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Together, you can build anything!
So they tried again, TOGETHER! Tumble lifted the heavy squares, and Pip pushed them into place.
Let's count the squares! One, two, three, four! Four squares make the walls!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Now the roof! Where does the triangle go, Pip?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Up, up, UP! A little to the left... a little to the right... perfect!
Clunk! The triangle sat on top like a pointy hat. Not on Tumble's head this time!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: We're a super-duper team!
Next, the playhouse needed a window. Pip found a shape that was round, round, round... just like the sun!
What shape is round like the sun? Can you shout it out?
A CIRCLE! Hooray, you got it!
Just then... GRUMBLE-RUMBLE! What was that noise? A grumbly bear?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! That's just my tummy. That circle looks like a yummy pancake! HONK!
Everybody giggled... even the little snail on the fence!

narration.text: Last of all, they needed a shiny yellow star for the very top.
Tumble lifted the star... but then his trunk got tickly. Ah... ah... AH-CHOO!
WHOOSH! The star flew up, up, up... and landed right on top of the roof! Ka-BOING!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A star with five points! That was the best sneeze EVER!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: And a pink heart for the door, just for Nana!
Let's remember! What shape was the pointy roof?
A TRIANGLE! Three sides! Woo-hoo!
And what shape was the round window?
A CIRCLE! You remembered!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Squares, a triangle, a circle, a star and a heart! We used them all!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! What a wonderful playhouse! And you built it together!
And guess what? Her glasses slid down her beak again. Wheeee!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Teamwork makes everything better! HONK!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper teamwork! Goodnight, little shape house!
